item.title: Report: These 20 companies are paying poverty wages
item.description: Over the last 50 years, the chasm between average worker pay and CEO compensation has cracked wide open. item.title: ‘A threat to the survival of the planet’: Insider trading fears rise over Polymarket nuclear war market
item.description: Nuclear detonation could mark the start of World War III, plunging the planet into the deadliest conflict in human history. item.title: Trump assaulted renewable energy. Now America is more vulnerable to Iran’s fossil fuel shocks
item.description: Throughout his presidency, Donald Trump has hindered the growth of renewable energy and instead propped up fossil fuels like oil and coal. item.title: Can an AI chatbot be held responsible for a user’s death? A lawsuit against Google’s Gemini is about to test that
item.description: A Florida man initially began using Google’s Gemini AI platform last August for assistance with typical queries. By early October, the chatbot had driven him to commit suicide, claims a lawsuit filed against the tech giant on Wednesday. The father of Jonathan Gavalas is suing Alphabet, Google’s parent company, for monetary and punitive damages after discovering troubling messages in the chat logs that the 36-year-old exchanged with Gemini 2.5 Pro, Google’s latest AI model at the time. item.description: An agriculture commissioner race is probably not where you would expect the politics of AI to play out. Yet that’s exactly what happened in this week’s Republican primary in Texas. item.title: Is it time to update your career goals? (And if so, how?)
item.description: Every important endeavor in your life needs some kind of North Star to help you determine whether you’re succeeding.
